title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 056
review_goal: Differentiate diamond, disabled, and drawer variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Cut gemstone shape with a flat top center facets and pointed bottom
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a cut gemstone with visible facet lines across the center.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain diamond outline when the shape should stay empty inside.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a flat crown and several facet lines to a pointed gem shape.

items.depicts_observation: Wheelchair symbol with a seated figure above one large rear wheel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a seated wheelchair figure with an upright torso and wheel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the leaning wheelchair figure when the upper body should angle forward.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a seated stick figure with an upright torso over one large wheel.

items.depicts_observation: Wheelchair symbol with a leaning figure above one large rear wheel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the wheelchair figure leaning forward into the wheel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the more upright wheelchair symbol when the upper body should stay straight.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot tilts the figure forward and angles the arm above the same large wheel.

items.depicts_observation: Tall chest form with three drawers stacked above two short feet
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tall chest with three stacked drawers and tiny feet.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two drawer cabinet when the top should not extend into a third drawer.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot clearly stacks three drawer fronts inside one tall cabinet frame.

items.depicts_observation: Small cabinet form with two drawers flat top and two short feet
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a compact two drawer cabinet with a flat top panel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the three drawer chest when a taller stacked cabinet should be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shortens the cabinet and keeps only two drawer fronts above the feet.
